blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust applied to Gaming & Interactive Media. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Gaming economics run on retention, live-ops velocity and trust: player analytics into content decisions, live-ops automation, fraud/cheating defense and community safety. Live-service titles are decision engines running at player scale.

items: Cheating/economy exploits drain trust; detection reactive.
Telemetry rich but decision loops slow; content bets anecdotal.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC, Cyber Resilience & Incident Recovery, Cloud Security & Posture Management from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Player analytics, Live-ops, Trust & safety) on Dataq Sentinel and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — Privacy (minors) among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Detection that keeps pace: intelligence-driven SOC with the boring parts (tuning, coverage) done properly.
Identity as the perimeter: workforce, customer and machine identities on one governed plane.
Secure at the control plane: posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Technology & SaaS level this capability reads as: continuous SOC 2/ISO evidence with framework-unified register (audit prep down 60-80%). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
